ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with high macro-level contrast; approximately 70% low-intensity (black) pixels localized centrally and 30% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black mass extending from the peduncle across the central 2/3 of both lobes; distinct white geometric patches on the outer distal lobes. Left lobe features high-contrast white linear overlays on a black base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees relative to the lobe centers.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels along the continuous linear boundary; significantly more jagged/irregular at the distal lateral margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular pixel cluster (approx. 8 pixels diameter) in the high-intensity region of the right lobe. Clusters of white high-contrast pixels concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density of parallel, white-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) on the left lobe's black surface; at least three distinct sets of parallel lines with varying orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel-line scarring patterns (rake marks) indicative of historical trauma on the left lobe. Irregular, jagged tissue profiles at the distal tips suggesting wear or minor amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: A single isolated, high-contrast dark focal point located within the white pigmentation field of the right lobe, approximately 75% distal from the notch.
